auth.signupDescription: Start a calm daily English habit.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then log in.
auth.intro: Make room for your English. Short daily lessons, real conversation, and feedback that stays with you.

onboarding.heading: Build a daily plan that fits your English life.
onboarding.body: These choices help the coach prepare short lessons and feedback that match your level, goal, and available time.
onboarding.timeTitle: How much time feels realistic each day?

coach.dailyMotivation: Small steps count. Let's make today's one feel good.
coach.headerReady: Your {minutes} minute session is ready when you are.
coach.headerPrepare: Make a little room for your {minutes} minute English session.
coach.headerCompleted: Today's session is complete. Take that confidence with you.
coach.insightFirst: Start small: say one sentence aloud, even if it feels imperfect. Finding your voice takes practice, not perfection.
coach.insightReturning: Keep a useful phrase from your lesson in mind. Try using it in our next conversation to make it your own.
coach.insightCompleted: Before you move on, choose one phrase from today's lesson and say it in a sentence about your own life.
coach.insightSaved: Your notebook has feedback you can build on. Choose one correction and try it aloud before our next conversation.

insightAdvice.grammar: Your notebook includes grammar corrections. Try saying one corrected sentence aloud, then change a few words to make it your own.
insightAdvice.vocabulary: You have vocabulary feedback to revisit. Choose one corrected word and use it in a sentence about your day.
insightAdvice.word_order: Your notebook includes word-order corrections. Read one improved sentence slowly, then try the same pattern with a new idea.
insightAdvice.tone: Your saved feedback includes tone. Try saying the corrected phrase as if you were speaking to someone you know.
insightAdvice.clarity: Your notebook has feedback on clarity. Try expressing one idea in a short sentence before adding more detail.
insightAdvice.other: Let's build on your saved feedback. Say one corrected sentence aloud and use it as a starting point for a new one.

missionTitles.personal_growth: Make English part of your day

coach.name: Zaban
coach.welcome: A little English. A little more confidence.
coach.newMessage: You do not need perfect English to begin. Let's take one small step together.
coach.returnMessage: You are making time for your English. Let's keep that rhythm going.
coach.completedMessage: You showed up for yourself today. Well done. Your lesson is here whenever you want to revisit it.
coach.advice: Say your answers aloud. Give yourself time to find the words.
coach.missionIntro: A short session shaped around your level and learning goal. Let's get it ready.
coach.missionReady: Your session is ready. A few useful words, a little reading, and a chance to speak.
coach.missionCompleted: Today's session is complete. Revisit the lesson at your own pace.
coach.weeklyActivity: Practice activity over the last seven days
coach.conversationNudge: Try out a few words with me. We will take it one message at a time.
coach.notebookNudge: Turn a small correction into your next moment of confidence.
coach.conversationObjective: Focus on expressing your thoughts naturally, one reply at a time.
coach.reviewHint: Read the correction aloud, then try it in a sentence of your own.
coach.notebookMessage: Every correction is something you can use next time. Let's make it stick.

objectives.travel: Feel at home in new places
objectives.personal_growth: Make English part of your day

dashboard.eyebrow: Ready for your {minutes} minute English practice?
dashboard.heading: Your focused English practice is ready.
dashboard.body: A calm plan with vocabulary, one useful sentence, short input, and a speaking prompt.
dashboard.practiceAction: Build your daily habit, one focused lesson at a time.
dashboard.conversationAction: Put your English into words with your AI coach.
dashboard.patternsHint: Keep practicing. Useful corrections from your conversations will appear here.
dashboard.completed: Today's lesson is completed and available for review.
dashboard.none: No lesson has been generated for today yet.

practice.heading: Today's English practice
practice.body: A focused lesson for your level, goal, and local calendar day.
practice.generateBody: Your lesson is created once for your local calendar day and reused for review after you finish.
practice.pendingBody: Generation is already in progress. Refresh in a moment to see the finished practice.
practice.failedBody: The coach could not create today's lesson. You can try again.
practice.sentenceHint: Read it slowly, then say it aloud three times with natural rhythm.
practice.speakingHint: Speak aloud independently. This practice does not record audio or score pronunciation.

conversation.heading: Practice a short English conversation.
conversation.body: Pick a topic, send a message, and get a concise reply with useful corrections when they matter.
conversation.emptyBody: The coach will ask one question at a time and give small, useful corrections when needed.
conversation.sendHint: Send a short message. The coach will reply and correct up to two important mistakes.

progress.heading: Your recent English practice
progress.body: Practice days are counted from completed lessons or completed conversation exchanges, using your local calendar day.
progress.noWeakAreas: No correction patterns have been observed yet.

mistakes.heading: Review corrections from real practice.
mistakes.body: These entries come from saved conversation corrections. Treat them as useful feedback, not a full assessment of your English.
mistakes.syncBody: Bring recent conversation feedback into your notebook.
mistakes.noSaved: No saved corrections yet. Conversation feedback can be synced here when it appears.

intelligence.reason: Based on your recent corrections, practice {area}.
intelligence.newFocus: Build confidence with a short lesson toward your goal.
intelligence.grammarReviewed: Practiced English examples and sentence patterns.
intelligence.speakingPracticed: Completed the independent speaking prompt. Speaking was not assessed.
intelligence.next: Revisit {area} with a short example and a new sentence.
intelligence.nextDefault: Describe yesterday’s activities in a few English sentences.

memory.beginning: Your learning story starts with the next short session. As you practice, your coach will notice useful patterns.
memory.rhythm: You made room for English on {count} days in the last seven days.
memory.historical: A pattern from earlier practice; a short review can show what still needs attention.
memory.noPattern: There is not enough repeated feedback to identify a lasting challenge yet.
memory.next: Try three new English sentences focusing on {area}, then use one in a conversation.
memory.nextDefault: Complete a short lesson, then use one of its words in a conversation.
memory.weeklySubtitle: The last seven days, including today, in your timezone.
memory.sessionDefinition: Sessions are completed lessons and ended conversations with at least one answered message. Vocabulary counts are review opportunities, including repeated words.
memory.grammarPractice: {count} completed lessons included sentence practice. This records practice, not assessed grammar accuracy.
memory.lowerFeedback: Fewer {area} corrections per exchange than in the previous seven days. Topics and task difficulty may differ.
memory.noComparison: More comparable conversation practice is needed before showing a feedback trend.
memory.emptyWeek: No completed sessions in the last seven days yet. Your earlier learning history is still remembered.
memory.unavailable: Your learning history is temporarily unavailable. You can keep practicing; your coach will reconnect to it later.
memory.privacy: Learning patterns only; personal conversation details are not saved in coach memory.
memory.grammarFeedback: You received {count} grammar corrections in conversations over the last seven days.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.description: Manage access and support each learner.
admin.confirmBody: This changes the learner’s access immediately. Review the account and action before confirming.
admin.invalid: Check the selected values and try again.
admin.conflict: This account has changed. Refresh and review its current status.
admin.failed: Unable to complete this request. Please try again.
admin.loadFailed: Unable to load this information. Please try again.
admin.pendingBody: Your account is waiting for administrator approval. You can start learning once your account is approved. No email confirmation is required.
admin.suspendedBody: Learning access is currently paused. Contact your administrator for assistance.
admin.rejectedBody: Learning access is unavailable. Contact your administrator if you believe this was a mistake.
admin.pendingDescription: Review new accounts before granting learning access.
admin.self: Use your own account preferences to edit your profile. You cannot change your own access here.
admin.authFailed: Unable to sign in. Check your details and try again.
admin.signupFailed: Unable to create your account. Please try again.
admin.registrationUnavailable: Registration is temporarily unavailable. Please contact the administrator.
admin.signupNote: New accounts require administrator approval. No email confirmation is required.
admin.practiceDays: Practice days in the summary week
admin.noMemory: No saved learning summary is available.
admin.noPatterns: Not enough repeated feedback to identify a pattern.
admin.timeNote: Account timestamps are shown in UTC.
